testsuite.name: gg.rsmod.plugins.content.combat.formula.MeleeCombatFormulaTests

testcase.name: melee strength equipment bonus (BonusSlot STRENGTH_BONUS) composes into max hit
Aggressive style gives effective Strength the largest, plus 3, bonus
getAccuracyAgainstReducedDefence with a stab defence style reads the stab bonus whatever the attack style
Accurate style gives effective Strength no style bonus, same as Defensive
a level 1, unequipped, un-prayed attacker deals the minimum baseline hit
Controlled style gives effective Strength a plus 1 bonus
getAccuracyAgainstReducedDefence rolls the normal attack against a fraction of the defence roll
TargetModifiers' Salve amulet bonus multiplies the base hit rather than replacing it
void melee multiplies effective Strength by 1_10 and floors it
protect from melee only zeroes accuracy against a non-player attacker
Piety's Strength prayer multiplier composes into effective Strength
Accurate style's plus 3 effective Attack bonus composes into the attack roll
